flows.name: Sun Salutation
flows.description: A standard 12-step sequence of yoga postures synchronized with breath (Surya Namaskar).

steps.englishVoicePrompt: Step 1: Prayer Pose. Stand at the front of your mat, palms together at your heart. Exhale and center yourself.
steps.sanskritVoicePrompt: प्रथमं सोपानम्: प्रणामासनम्। करसम्पुटं हृदयस्थाने धारयन्तु। निःश्वस्य शान्तं भवन्तु।

steps.englishVoicePrompt: Step 2: Raised Arms Pose. Inhale deeply, sweep your arms up and arch back slightly, stretching your whole body.
steps.sanskritVoicePrompt: द्वितीयं सोपानम्: हस्तौत्तानासनम्। श्वासं स्वीकृत्य हस्तौ ऊर्ध्वं उत्थापयन्तु। शरीरं दीर्घतानन्तु।

steps.englishVoicePrompt: Step 3: Standing Forward Bend. Exhale, hinge from your hips and fold forward, bringing your hands to the mat.
steps.sanskritVoicePrompt: तृतीयं सोपानम्: उत्तानासनम्। निःश्वस्य अधोगत्वा पार्श्वपादौ स्पृशन्तु। शिरोग्रीवं शिथिलीकुर्यात्।

steps.englishVoicePrompt: Step 4: Lunge Pose. Inhale, step your right leg far back, drop the knee, and lift your chest, gazing forward.
steps.sanskritVoicePrompt: चतुर्थं सोपानम्: अश्वसञ्चालनासनम्। श्वासं स्वीकृत्य दक्षिणपादं पृष्ठे स्थापयन्तु। वक्षःप्रसास्य अग्रे पश्यन्तु।

steps.englishVoicePrompt: Step 5: Plank Pose. Hold your breath and step your left foot back to meet the right. Keep your body in a straight line.
steps.sanskritVoicePrompt: पञ्चमं सोपानम्: फलकासनम्। कुम्भकं कृत्वा वामपादं पृष्ठे स्थापयन्तु। शरीरं सरलरेखा-रूपेण धारयन्तु।

steps.englishVoicePrompt: Step 6: Eight-Limbed Pose. Exhale, lower your knees, chest, and chin to the mat, keeping your hips slightly raised.
steps.sanskritVoicePrompt: षष्ठं सोपानम्: अष्टाङ्गनमस्कारः। निःश्वस्य जानु-वक्षः-हनु भूमौ स्थापयन्तु। नितम्बं ईषत् उन्नतम्।

steps.englishVoicePrompt: Step 7: Cobra Pose. Inhale, slide forward and lift your chest, keeping your elbows bent and close to your body.
steps.sanskritVoicePrompt: सप्तमं सोपानम्: भुजङ्गासनम्। श्वासं स्वीकृत्य वक्षः उत्थापयन्तु। कूर्परौ शरीरस्य समीपे स्थापयन्तु।

steps.englishVoicePrompt: Step 8: Downward-Facing Dog. Exhale, tuck your toes and lift your hips high and back into an inverted V.
steps.sanskritVoicePrompt: अष्टमं सोपानम्: अधोमुखश्वानासनम्। निःश्वस्य नितम्बं ऊर्ध्वं उत्थापयन्तु। सर्वशरीरं पर्वताकारं धारयन्तु।

steps.englishVoicePrompt: Step 9: Lunge Pose. Inhale, step your right foot forward between your hands and drop your left knee.
steps.sanskritVoicePrompt: नवमं सोपानम्: अश्वसञ्चालनासनम्। श्वासं स्वीकृत्य दक्षिणपादं अग्रे स्थापयन्तु। वामजानुं भूमौ धारयन्तु।

steps.englishVoicePrompt: Step 10: Standing Forward Bend. Exhale, step your left foot forward and fold deeply into your legs.
steps.sanskritVoicePrompt: दशमं सोपानम्: उत्तानासनम्। निःश्वस्य वामपादं अग्रे स्थापयन्तु। पूर्णतया अधो नमन्तु।

steps.englishVoicePrompt: Step 11: Raised Arms Pose. Inhale, rise all the way up, sweep your arms overhead and gently arch back.
steps.sanskritVoicePrompt: एकादशं सोपानम्: हस्तौत्तानासनम्। श्वासं स्वीकृत्य ऊर्ध्वं गत्वा हस्तौ प्रसारयन्तु। वक्षः उद्भासन्तु।

steps.englishVoicePrompt: Step 12: Prayer Pose. Exhale and lower your hands back to your heart. Stand quiet and observe the energy.
steps.sanskritVoicePrompt: द्वादशं सोपानम्: प्रणामासनम्। निःश्वस्य हस्तौ हृदयस्थाने स्थापयन्तु। शान्तं अनुभवन्तु।

flows.name: Warrior Strength
flows.description: A powerful flow of standing postures to build core stability and focus.

steps.englishVoicePrompt: Start in Mountain Pose. Ground your feet and stand tall with focused breath.
steps.sanskritVoicePrompt: ताडासनं कुर्यात्। समस्थिति। पादौ भूमौ धारयन्तु।

steps.englishVoicePrompt: Step back with your left foot into Warrior I. Reach your arms high and square your hips.
steps.sanskritVoicePrompt: वीरभद्रासनं प्रथमम्। वामपादं पृष्ठे स्थापयन्तु। हस्तौ ऊर्ध्वं प्रसारयन्तु।

steps.englishVoicePrompt: Open your hips and arms out wide for Warrior II. Gaze over your front hand.
steps.sanskritVoicePrompt: वीरभद्रासनं द्वितीयम्। हस्तौ पार्श्वे प्रसारयन्तु। अग्रे पश्यन्तु।

steps.englishVoicePrompt: Straighten your front leg and lean into Triangle Pose. Reach high through your top hand.
Lower down and rest in Child's Pose. Release all effort.
steps.sanskritVoicePrompt: बालासनम्। नितम्बौ पादपृष्ठे स्थापयन्तु। शिरो भूमौ नमन्तु।

flows.name: Deep Restorative Yin
flows.description: A relaxing, low-intensity series of holds designed to release deep connective tissues and soothe the nervous system.

steps.englishVoicePrompt: Yin Step 1: Child's Pose, Balasana. Bring your knees wide, sink your hips back, and relax your forehead on the mat. Feel the breath soothing your back.
Yin Step 2: Sphinx Pose. Prop yourself onto your forearms, relaxing your lower body completely. Lift your chest gently and enjoy this mild back-bend.
Yin Step 3: Butterfly Pose, Baddha Konasana. Bring the soles of your feet together, letting your knees open wide. Fold forward slightly to release the hips.
Yin Step 4: Reclined Spinal Twist. Lay on your back and drop your knees to the side. Open your chest flat toward the sky, breathing ease into your spine.
Yin Step 5: Corpse Pose, Savasana. Lie completely flat on your back, letting your whole body surrender. Close your eyes, be absolutely still, and rest. Namaste.

flows.name: Morning Energizer
flows.description: Start your day with a gentle, refreshing sequence to awaken your senses, stretch your limbs, and bring vibrant focus to your morning.

steps.englishVoicePrompt: Energizer Step 1: Mountain Pose, or Tadasana. Wake up your body by standing tall and breathing deeply. Ground your feet and prepare your mind for the day.
Energizer Step 2: Raised Arms Pose. Sweep your arms high to greet the morning. Stretch toward the sky and lift your heart.
Energizer Step 3: Forward Bend. Exhale and hinge from your hips. Fold forward, letting your neck relax completely and releasing any stiffness from sleep.
Energizer Step 4: Downward Dog. Step back and press your hips up and back. Stretch your spine and awaken your hamstrings with a gentle pedaling motion.
Energizer Step 5: Child's Pose. Bring your knees wide and sink your hips to your heels. Breathe deeply and feel a sense of calm gratitude for the day ahead.

flows.name: Bedtime Wind Down
flows.description: A slow, calming sequence of grounded holds to release the tension of the day and prepare your mind and body for a deep, restful sleep.

steps.englishVoicePrompt: Wind Down Step 1: Child's Pose. Rest your body on the mat. Take slow, soothing breaths and feel the busyness of the day fade away.
Wind Down Step 2: Butterfly Pose. Bring your feet together and let your knees relax outward. Lean forward slightly and release any tension in your hips.
Wind Down Step 3: Reclined Spinal Twist. Lay back and let your knees drift to the side. Breathe deeply into your back, letting your body decompress.
Wind Down Step 4: Savasana, or Corpse Pose. Lie completely flat, letting every muscle go limp. Close your eyes, sink into the mat, and drift into a peaceful rest.

flows.name: Core & Balance Builder
flows.description: Focus your energy on stability and core strength with this sequence that challenges your balance and tones your core muscles.

steps.englishVoicePrompt: Step 1: Mountain Pose. Find your balance and establish a strong, tall stance. Ground your feet into the earth.
Step 2: Warrior 1. Step your left leg back, reach high, and lift your chest. Stand solid and strong.
Step 3: Warrior 2. Open your arms and body to the side. Look forward past your hand, finding absolute stability.
Step 4: Plank Pose. Lower into a strong plank posture. Pull your belly button in tight and support your body with core power.
Step 5: Downward-Facing Dog. Elevate your hips and release your heels downward. Let your back lengthen and take deep, centering breaths.

flows.name: Heart Opening Vinyasa
flows.description: An uplifting flow centering on backbends and chest expansion to open your heart, release upper body stiffness, and boost your energy.

steps.englishVoicePrompt: Opening Step 1: Mountain Pose. Stand tall and ground yourself, feeling the space around your chest expand.
Opening Step 2: Raised Arms Pose. Reach up and arch back slightly, stretching your chest toward the light.
Opening Step 3: Sphinx Pose. Rest on your forearms, lift your chest gently, and feel your collarbones broaden.
Opening Step 4: Cobra Pose. Press into your palms and roll your shoulders back. Lift your heart and breathe energy into your upper back.
Opening Step 5: Child's Pose. Relax down completely. Absorb the openness of your chest and rest your heart on the mat.

flows.name: Power Vinyasa Ascent
flows.description: An intense, fast-paced advanced vinyasa flow that builds stamina, muscle strength, and deep athletic concentration.

steps.englishVoicePrompt: Vinyasa Step 1: Plank Pose. Ignite your core immediately. Hold this posture strong, building heat in your belly and arms.
Vinyasa Step 2: Eight-Limbed Pose. Lower with control, keeping your elbows close to your chest and your focus sharp.
Vinyasa Step 3: Cobra Pose. Inhale and lift up, opening your front body. Feel the strength of your spine working.
Vinyasa Step 4: Downward Dog. Push back and breathe deeply. Use this pose to center yourself and stretch out your spine.
Vinyasa Step 5: Warrior 1. Step up with power. Reach high, bend your front knee, and sink into your hips with complete focus.
Vinyasa Step 6: Warrior 2. Open up with strength. Direct your energy through both hands, standing solid as a rock.

flows.name: Ashtanga Core Power
flows.description: An advanced, core-centric sequence of strong postures requiring intense muscle activation, breath control, and persistent focus.

steps.englishVoicePrompt: Step 1: Plank Pose. Establish a firm core. Breathe steadily and let your muscles engage.
Step 2: Warrior 1. Step up with determination. Press your feet down, lift your arms, and center your focus.
Step 3: Warrior 2. Open into a powerful stance. Gaze forward and find absolute clarity.
Step 4: Cobra Pose. Slide onto your belly and lift your chest, engaging your entire back body.
Step 5: Downward Dog. Push back, stretching your legs and centering your mind for the final hold.
Step 6: Child's Pose. Relax and surrender. Let your heartbeat slow down and enjoy the sweet release.

flows.name: Advanced Balance Mastery
flows.description: Push the boundaries of your stability and deep focus with a sequence of challenging standing balances and grounding postures.

steps.englishVoicePrompt: Mastery Step 1: Mountain Pose. Stand tall and completely still. Ground your mind and body.
Mastery Step 2: Warrior 1. Ground your back foot firmly. Elevate your spine and settle your hips deep.
Mastery Step 3: Warrior 2. Stretch wide and stay steady, focusing your gaze forward with intent.
Mastery Step 4: Triangle Pose. Hinge forward and open your heart to the side. Maintain absolute balance.
Mastery Step 5: Child's Pose. Rest and breathe, releasing all physical effort.
Mastery Step 6: Savasana. Complete your balance practice with pure relaxation. Rest deeply.

flows.name: Norwegian 4x4
flows.description: A science-backed HIIT protocol — 4 minutes of high-intensity work followed by 3 minutes of active recovery, repeated 4 times. Works with running, cycling, swimming, or any vigorous activity.

steps.englishVoicePrompt: Warm Up. Start with 3 minutes of light-to-moderate effort. Choose your activity — brisk walking, easy jogging, or dynamic stretches — and gradually raise your heart rate.
Round 1 High Intensity. Go hard for 4 minutes. Push at 85 to 95 percent of your maximum effort. You should be breathing heavily and unable to hold a conversation.
Round 1 Recovery. 3 minutes of active recovery. Slow down to a gentle pace — walk, cycle easily, or swim slowly. Keep moving and focus on controlled breathing.
Round 2 High Intensity. Push again for 4 minutes. Maintain your effort level. Dig deep — this is where the gains happen.
Round 2 Recovery. 3 minutes of active recovery. Let your heart rate come back down. Steady, gentle movement.
Round 3 High Intensity. You are halfway there. 4 minutes at 85 to 95 percent max effort. Trust your body and keep pushing.
Round 3 Recovery. 3 minutes of active recovery. One more round to go — use this time wisely to recover.
Round 4 High Intensity. Final push. 4 minutes. Leave everything out there. This is your last work interval — give it everything you have.
Round 4 Recovery. 3 minutes of active recovery. You have completed all 4 intervals. Great work. Keep moving gently as your breathing steadies.
Cool Down. 3 minutes. Gradually wind down — slow walking, gentle stretches, deep breaths. Reflect on your effort. You crushed it. Namaste.
